name: Andrew McCormack
current_role: Co-founder and managing partner of Valar Ventures
summary: Andrew McCormack joined PayPal in 2001 and worked closely with Peter Thiel there and later at Clarium Capital and Thiel Capital. In 2010 he co-founded the venture firm Valar Ventures with Thiel and James Fitzgerald, which he runs with Fitzgerald. He appeared in Fortune's 2007 PayPal Mafia photo.
